scope: Test transfer of the documented 2019 SGD recipe to our current policy-only 233M CNN and fixed 9x9 weak-teacher dataset. Preserve exact position/symmetry exposure multiset, initialization and full validation population; shuffle and regroup into 256-position batches. Optimizer, batch grouping/order, schedule and regularization change jointly. Equal exposures, not equal optimizer updates or training FLOPs. AdamW 1e-3 was selected from four rates; SGD is a single registered control. This is not a reproduction of the original 2019 self-play system or a Go-strength/RL-efficiency comparison.
